title: S3 ACC Project Onboarding

steps.action: Create project from governed ACC template.
Create governed folder structure and platform services required by the project.
Apply role groups and least-privilege permissions while keeping technical platform capability distinct from the responsibility for ISO 19650 review, approval, authorization and acceptance activities.

Configure Work in Progress, Shared, Published and Archived mappings so the platform implements the governed ISO 19650 CDE lifecycle. Work in Progress to Shared shall map to the applicable approval-for-sharing process (Decision A mapping); Shared to Published shall map to the applicable authorization and acceptance process (Decision B mapping).

Configure traceability for Decision A and Decision B transitions to the applicable review, decision outcome, responsible ISO 19650 party or project-mapped function, information scope, status or permitted use, and evidence reference. Where Decision B is separated under the applicable ISO 19650-2 delivery process, preserve lead-appointed-party authorization and appointing-party acceptance as distinct traceable activities.

Configure S5 coordination issues, reviews and sign-off as supplementary collaborative-production controls. Coordination status or sign-off shall not replace the ISO 19650 approval-for-sharing, authorization or acceptance activities required for the applicable CDE transition.

Review the configured environment against project information requirements, the S3 CDE state registry, the S5 coordination controls, the S7 ISO 19650 delivery sequence, and applicable project appointment and authority instruments before production use.

Record unresolved mappings where ACC cannot directly represent the governed ISO 19650 transition semantics; document the implementation mapping rather than substituting a misleading platform status or supplementary TIVERIT decision.

outputs: Decision A and Decision B transition traceability configuration
governance_notes: ACC is the implementation platform; the ISO 19650 process governs the meaning of the applicable CDE state transitions.

Decision A maps Work in Progress to Shared through the applicable review and approval-for-sharing activity. Decision B maps Shared to Published through the applicable authorization and acceptance process.
Platform roles, permissions and workflow actions do not independently assign the ISO 19650 party responsibilities established by the project appointment and information-management arrangements.
TIVERIT coordination sign-off, milestone approval and handover acceptance remain supplementary decisions where applicable and shall not replace Decision A or Decision B.
This object does not supersede the generic W1.2 CDE setup workflow; both workflows shall implement the same ISO 19650 transition semantics.

provenance.migration_note: ISO-IMP-005 re-audit aligns ACC onboarding to the ISO 19650 CDE lifecycle and explicitly maps Decision A to Work in Progress-to-Shared and Decision B to Shared-to-Published while retaining S5 coordination as supplementary governance.
